title: Block wizard output source path overlap
summary: Settings Wizard path validation now blocks final output, per-library output, and promotion destination folders that exactly match any enabled source library folder.
reason: The wizard must keep completed-output destinations separate from source libraries so coordinator setup does not create a source/output overlap that conflicts with the project's no-touch source boundary.
behavior_before: The wizard blocked Scratch / LocalBase when it matched an enabled source library, but it did not block Final output root, a library output destination, or a promotion destination from matching a source library path.
behavior_after: The wizard blocks Preview Config and Save & Reload when Final output root, an explicit library output destination, or an enabled promotion destination exactly matches any enabled source library path.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - blocked by unrelated invalid packet ops/release/changes/unreleased/MP-CHANGE-2026-0613-004.json type bug_fix
rollback_plan: Revert the source/output overlap validation additions in src/mediapipeline/core/config/settings_wizard.py and the related tests in tests/python/desktop/test_settings_wizard_policy.py.
notes: Add wizard validation blockers when output roots equal enabled source roots.
